metadata.description: A deliberate near-duplicate of the parameter declarations (and the definitions they reference) of the Azure Verified Modules module avm/res/cognitive-services/account at tag 0.19.2, kept so the tests that render the catalog Recipes run offline. Its resources and outputs are a minimal stand-in. The real module is proven by the example's committed output.
Optional. The name of the Cognitive Services account deployment.
Required. Properties of the deployment model.
Optional. The resource model definition representing the SKU.
Optional. The name of the RAI policy.
Optional. The version upgrade option.

Optional. Model-provider attestation required by the Cognitive Services resource provider for partner models such as Anthropic Claude. Documented in [Deploy and use Claude on Microsoft Foundry](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/developer/ai/how-to/deploy-claude-foundry#terms-of-use). This property is not yet reflected in the published OpenAPI spec (tracked in [Azure/azure-rest-api-specs#43610](https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/issues/43610)), so its exact shape may still change once the spec is updated.
